description.value:
You touch a creature, granting it uncanny freedom from mundane delay for the duration: signals turn in its favor, paths open before it, and it can move at full speed through crowded or cluttered spaces. Attacks of opportunity provoked by the target's movement are made with disadvantage, and the target has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, since concealment always seems available. The target also has advantage on ability checks made to pilot or drive a vehicle.

If two creatures under this power's effect would inconvenience each other, each makes a Charisma check when their interests conflict; the higher result prevails.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
